podcast.title: Use of Devil's Triad
podcast.body: Liszt, a renowned classical composer, is included among "dozens" of classical artists who incorporated the "devil's tri tone" (flattened fifth) into their musical creations. This underscores the widespread historical application of this interval across various periods and styles within classical music. "But then it did show up in a lot of classical compositions from people like Beethoven, Wagner, Debussy, Lyst, Sabelius, Bartok, dozens of others."
